bug_semantics: Authenticated IDOR/CWE-99 in JobLogController.logDetailCat: a caller-supplied logId is used as the sole resource identifier to load an XxlJobLog row and then fetch that job's rolling execution log from the stored executor, without JobGroupPermissionUtil.validJobGroupPermission (or any equivalent job-group check). Sibling logDetailPage does enforce group permission, so a non-admin user restricted to one job group can still read another group's log content by enumerating logId. Logs may contain job parameters, stack traces, internal addresses, and secrets printed by handlers.
flaw_origin: The logId-as-resource-identifier path was first written in 9293c61ca0a8d54afdfb27cc568885ae639a14dc (2023-03-23, "CVE-2022-43183" SSRF fix). The parent still took client-supplied executorAddress/triggerTime; this commit rewrote logDetailCat to xxlJobLogDao.load(logId) plus getExecutorBiz(jobLog.getExecutorAddress()) and omitted the job-group permission already used on pageList/index (JobInfoController.validPermission / filterJobGroupByRole since 2019). Later refactors renamed types/packages but kept the missing check. 36332fd3 (2025-04-30) added the group check only to logDetailPage. Advisory-cited d24e4ccd (2026-03-29) only changes log-list filtering/index and does not close the sink. The actual sink close is 7a5239f3b4275bc486490f8c835d10198ef4881e (2026-06-19), first tagged 3.4.2.
ai_marker: absent; BIC author/committer xuxueli <931591021@qq.com>; git cat-file -p 9293c61ca0a8d54afdfb27cc568885ae639a14dc has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Signed-off-by AI, or bot identity; message is only '"CVE-2022-43183" SSRF漏洞修复。'
evidence: CVE.org CVE-2026-7303 state=PUBLISHED (cveawg.mitre.org, dateUpdated 2026-04-29T13:11:38.122Z); CNA VulDB; not rejected/withdrawn. GHSA-gw2x-mfwr-h46p withdrawn_at=null, github_reviewed=true 2026-05-06. Vendor GitHub issue xuxueli/xxl-job#3936 was closed completed 2026-03-29 by owner with comment '存在 执行器 权限检验逻辑。' but that is not a CVE rejection; the later RollingLog permission commit treats the IDOR as real.

Issue #3936 PoC: authenticated non-admin user with one job-group can call GET /xxl-job-admin/joblog/logDetailCat?logId=<id>&fromLineNum=1 and receive another group's executor log; logDetailPage with the same id is denied by JobGroupPermissionUtil.validJobGroupPermission.

git show 730c1066b80e8ab44503ed34ced19ef8e0471fec:xxl-job-admin/src/main/java/com/xxl/job/admin/controller/JobLogController.java line 140: parent logDetailCat(String executorAddress, long triggerTime, long logId, int fromLineNum) calls XxlJobScheduler.getExecutorBiz(executorAddress) with no load-by-logId resource lookup.

BIC 9293c61ca0a8d54afdfb27cc568885ae639a14dc (single parent, 4 files, not a squash/move) first writes logDetailCat(long logId, int fromLineNum) at JobLogController.java:138-148: xxlJobLogDao.load(logId) then getExecutorBiz(jobLog.getExecutorAddress()) then executorBiz.log(LogParam(triggerTime, logId, fromLineNum)); no validPermission/validJobGroupPermission. git blame on those lines at the BIC points only at 9293c61.

Job-group authz already existed at BIC time: same file pageList/index used JobInfoController.validPermission; filterJobGroupByRole dates to 9329fb39e7560fd3f0ec428cd5a63d8d3555095c (2019-05-08). Endpoint itself first appeared in ae26cb0c5d9b177dec4a4293199a12e43d51eafb (2017) as an executorAddress SSRF surface, a different mechanism than CWE-99 via logId.

36332fd37490ab94fc101861c88bc927f2d88580 (2025-04-30, feat(AI) message) added PermissionInterceptor.validJobGroupPermission only to logDetailPage; git show of that commit does not touch logDetailCat. Not used as BIC (later sibling check, not first write of the logId sink).

Advisory-cited patch d24e4ccd6073cc75305e1d3b9c29bc8db7437e7a (2026-03-29, in tag v3.4.0) does not add a permission check inside logDetailCat; it only changes index/pageList jobGroup/jobId filtering and mapper WHERE. git show v3.4.0 and tag 3.4.1 still have logDetailCat(logId, fromLineNum) without validJobGroupPermission.

Direct fix 7a5239f3b4275bc486490f8c835d10198ef4881e parent af48317887e8273592266000450824f21e7df3c2: adds HttpServletRequest and JobGroupPermissionUtil.validJobGroupPermission(request, jobLog.getJobGroup()) after load(logId) in logDetailCat; message '任务RollingLog权限校验完善，防止越权查看任务日志；'. git merge-base --is-ancestor 7a5239f3 v3.4.0 / 3.4.1 = false; ancestor of tag 3.4.2 = true (3.4.2 = c2bbb46c9a3af8e2a69246728a452c606240b80e 2026-06-19).

Tag membership: BIC is ancestor of 2.4.0 (first containing tag, 0f867352 2023-03-23) through 3.3.2 and v3.4.0/3.4.1; not in 2.3.1. Affected GHSA range <3.4.0 is therefore too short on the high side (3.4.0/3.4.1 remain vulnerable) but the BIC does precede 3.3.2. Later path moves (d99271c9, 6873757d) are refactors, not BICs.
reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2026-7303/GHSA-gw2x-mfwr-h46p describe logDetailCat treating logId as an uncontrolled resource identifier (CWE-99/IDOR). CVE.org is PUBLISHED; GHSA is reviewed and not withdrawn. The GitHub issue was closed by the maintainer on 2026-03-29 claiming executor permission already existed, and VulDB/NVD pointed at d24e4ccd, but that commit does not add a job-group check on logDetailCat and v3.4.0/3.4.1 still serve logs by logId alone. The reporter's missing-check claim is confirmed in tree, and upstream later landed an explicit RollingLog authorization fix, so this is a real vulnerability rather than FALSE_POSITIVE. BIC search used the advisory sink (logDetailCat load-by-logId without group authz), not AI-marked commits. git log -S/-L and blame show the current sink was first written in 9293c61ca0a8d54afdfb27cc568885ae639a14dc when the SSRF fix replaced client-supplied executorAddress with xxlJobLogDao.load(logId). Immediate parent 730c1066b80e8ab44503ed34ced19ef8e0471fec still has the old signature and lacks those lines. 9293c61 is a small single-parent commit, not a squash/move/release. 2017's first logDetailCat write is a different (SSRF) mechanism; 2019 group permission made an authz gap possible, but the advisory's logId resource-injection lines appear only at the 2023 rewrite. 36332fd3 later added the sibling page check and has an feat(AI) subject, but that is not the first write of the flawed mechanism and is ignored for attribution per protocol. AI judgment is BIC-only: author/committer xuxueli, no AI/bot trailers, so NOT_AI. The direct fix is 7a5239f3b4275bc486490f8c835d10198ef4881e (first in 3.4.2), not the advisory SHA.
